summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Zentek Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting a press release about its subsidiary Albany Graphite Corp. engaging ERM Consultants for a second-year environmental and social baseline program at the Albany Graphite Project. The filing describes ongoing project development activities, including community partnership with Constance Lake First Nation and progress toward a Preliminary Economic Assessment. There are no special-situation corporate events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing is a routine operational update that does not trigger any event-driven special situation category.
